tools.name: savestate_snapshot
tools.description: Create an encrypted snapshot of current AI agent state

tools.name: savestate_restore
tools.description: Restore AI agent state from a snapshot

tools.name: savestate_status
tools.description: Check SaveState initialization and adapter status

resources.name: Snapshots
resources.description: List snapshots with bounded ?limit= and ?offset= pagination. Responses include total, count, remaining, offset, pageSize, nextOffset, nextUri, previousOffset, previousUri, suggestedOffset, and suggestedUri so agents can continue or recover a stale page.

resources.name: Memories
resources.description: List live memories with bounded ?limit= and ?offset= pagination plus ?search= (non-empty text query matched against content or tag values), ?type= (fact, event, preference, or conversation), ?tag= (non-empty tag), and inclusive ?minImportance= and ?maxImportance= filters from 0 through 1. Filters carry into continuation links. Responses include total, count, remaining, offset, pageSize, nextOffset, nextUri, previousOffset, previousUri, suggestedOffset, and suggestedUri so agents can continue or recover a stale page. Each memory includes metadata, createdAt, updatedAt, and expiresAt when set.
